{"operationName":"get","variables":{"id":"2595"},"query":"query get($id: bigint!) {
  campaigns_by_pk(id: $id) {
    id
    name
    status
    field_positions
    label_available_product
    product_display_type
    product_type
    product_tags
    internal_tags
    featured_image_url
    featured_image_thumbnail
    vendor
    platform_config
    campaign_products(order_by: {position: asc}) {
      id
      campaign_id
      product_id
      platform_title
      product {
        id
        title
        created_at
        inventory_locations
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    campaign_instances(where: {instance: {deleted_at: {_is_null: true}}}) {
      id
      instance_id
      status
      need_sync
      platform_linked_handle
      platform_linked_id
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}"}
